notes.title: New version of Tinker Bell / Upcoming Once a Porn a Time
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone!  
Here is the final version of the Tinker Bell Fairy for the upcoming [b][i]"Once a Porn a Time"[/i][/b] game! 💚  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891385/1eb2c4aafbfd6e09de6cc8dc1af28aeb3fdf6583.png"][/img]
I think this version is just perfect, it's like with Emee, she's instantly recognizable and the style is much more professional. [/p][p]With the great animations we have now, it will be just EXCELLENT! ✨ [/p][p]So, she will have two heads in-game, a "Fairy" version and a "Human size" version. [/p][p]I made a little image to show you the actual size difference in-game:   

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891385/b5310cd9ea10010a8cd96c30f51dfdf21e3ad577.jpg"][/img]
[i]I love her so much 💚💚💚  

[/i]As you can imagine, we couldn't realistically keep the fairy head for the human size, proportionally it would have looked too strange. So we're going with two versions![/p][p]I think her personality comes across well in both versions. 
And she'll be able to swap between them in-game whenever she wants!  

In other news, we're continuing to work on both the next OPT and the end of PnC!  

You can really feel that we have good organization, things are moving fast and smoothly, it's quite nice! ahah Anyway, I can't wait to release the final update of PnC on Steam, the game is rated [i]"Very Positive"[/i], so we can only expect a good launch!  

And also, don't hesitate to wishlist "Porn and Cards" on Steam if you're waiting for the final release, that way you won't miss it and it helps me A LOT! [/p][p]See you in a few days for the release of the next PnC update! 
Bye ~~[/p]

notes.title: Bugfix 1 // Coronation day
notes.notes:
A few corrections have been made to the game,
Firstly, the end of the game was apparently unreachable for some of you, this may have been due to the use of saves dating from before the steam release, so I recommend not using them.

Normally, the end of the game should now be accessible to all, I apologize for this bug which was not at all intentional, the steam version is there to be complete and without any restrictions.

A few other bugs have been fixed, such as Snow White's dress, which had a problem, and several other little things.

Anyway, sorry again for this inconvenience, I'm still making a few mistakes in my code, but I'm fixing it fast :)
I wish you all a great game!

notes.title: RELEASE TODAY // Once a Porn a Time

Hello everyone! ~
